resources.string: Privacy controls
Privacy and data
Back
Every change and deletion requires the parent PIN. DNS filtering stays on-device in both modes. New cloud consent and query-history sharing are off by default.
Local or cloud mode

Local mode stops Tracewall uploads and live rule/pairing listeners, and disables Firebase database networking. The identity and last valid remote rules stay on this device. Cloud mode permits pairing, parent rule updates and protection-off events; history and app names need their own consent.
Enable cloud mode…
Switch to local mode…
Allow Firebase database networking, pairing, remote rule updates and protection-off events? History and app-name sharing are separate choices below. Local history is never backfilled.

Stop Tracewall uploads and live listeners, and disable database networking? Already queued SDK writes are not recalled and may be sent when cloud mode or explicit deletion reconnects. This does not revoke parents or erase cloud data.
Reapply selected database mode
Independent sharing choices
Query-history consent: on
Query-history consent: off

Change query-history sharing? Only newly offered queries with current consent in cloud mode can upload. Enabling never uploads stored history or queries queued before consent. Turning off does not erase prior uploads or SDK-queued writes.
App-name consent: on
App-name consent: off

Change app-name sharing? It is not required for pairing. When off, app snapshot cleanup is best effort only in cloud mode and may wait for reconnect. Previously uploaded new-app events remain until explicit cloud deletion.

Consent choices are effective only in cloud mode. Local mode overrides both, but remembers them for an explicit reconnect. No local persistence does not disable separately approved query uploads. The 500-entry live in-memory view remains available.
Stored local history

Choose no persistence or 1, 3 or 7 days (default 7). Shorter retention immediately prunes Room and discards older queued work. Pruning also runs at startup and about once a minute while this process runs; it is not secure disk erasure. Exported files and cloud history are separate.

Retention saved and Room pruning completed.
Clear stored local history…

Delete all current Room history and discard pre-clear queued rows? A running insert is coordinated with deletion so old rows cannot reappear. New queries may appear immediately. Cloud uploads, the live view, exports and other app caches are not deleted.
Stored local rows removed: %1$d. Pre-clear queued rows were discarded.
Delete uploaded cloud data

Deletes only this child identity’s Firestore history, events, app-name snapshots and latest shared location. It leaves pairing, memberships, identity and parent-owned rules unchanged. It cannot erase copies already read or cached by a parent, exported files, Firebase caches or SDK writes by another process/device using the same identity.
Delete cloud uploads…
Retry pending cloud deletion…

Switch to local mode, turn both sharing consents off, stop location sharing, and temporarily connect Firestore ONLY to delete this child’s uploaded history, events, app names and latest location? Previously SDK-queued writes must be acknowledged first and may be sent before being deleted. Deletion uses bounded server reads and batches, then checks all four collections again. Offline/error/limit/time-out results stay pending; cloud sharing remains locked until a PIN-approved retry verifies deletion. No automatic reconnect for deletion occurs after restart.
Cloud deletion is not verified. It may be partial or waiting for network/server acknowledgment. Remain local and retry with the PIN. No success is claimed.
The server confirmed these four upload collections empty. Database networking is disabled and sharing remains off. Parent caches and other copies are not recalled.
Last verified empty: %1$s. This is not proof that parent caches or other copies were erased.
No cloud deletion has been verified for this app installation.
No retained Firebase child identity is available. Cloud deletion cannot be verified; an old identity lost by clearing app data cannot be recovered here.
The action did not complete. Retention may already be saved even if pruning failed; the writer will retry. No clear/deletion success is claimed.

Local mode: Firebase database networking disabled.
Cloud mode requested: enabling database networking…
Cloud mode is on, but no account is signed in on this device. Open Account and sign in with email/password. Tracewall never creates an anonymous identity in the background.
Cloud mode: database networking permitted. Server connectivity is not verified by this status.
